description: This source file defines the internal sealed class 'CounterAggregator' in the 'Orleans.Runtime' namespace. The class manages counter aggregation with optional tagging, providing methods to add measurements and collect current values as 'Measurement<long>'.

classes.name: CounterAggregator
classes.description: An internal sealed class responsible for aggregating counter metrics with optional tags. It supports adding measurements and collecting current aggregated value.

methods.name: CounterAggregator()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty tags array.

methods.name: CounterAggregator(in TagList tagList)
methods.description: Constructor initializing tags based on the provided TagList object, supporting up to four tags.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Property returning the current aggregated value.

methods.name: Add(long measurement)
methods.description: Method to atomically add a measurement to the current value.

methods.name: Collect()
methods.description: Method to collect and return the current measurement along with tags as a Measurement<long> object.
